breaks.quote: Melina saw through hers in 3 sessions. It took me years to see through mine.
breaks.why: The passage stays with Melina's health story and his own 20s, and never shows the reader how a verdict sentence like this shows up in the reader's own work, money, relationships or other areas.

breaks.quote: He didn't need more options. He needed the focus to stick with what he picked.
breaks.why: The case ends inside David's business and projects, with no turn to the reader and no quick examples of where else the reader's own life works this way.
